  • Method Details

    • close

      public void close() throws SevenZipException
      Close archive. No more archive operations are possible.
      Note: This method should be always called to free system resources.
      Specified by:
      close in interface ISimpleInArchive
      Throws:
      SevenZipException - 7-Zip or 7-Zip-JBinding error occurs. Use SevenZipException.printStackTraceExtended() to get stack traces of this SevenZipException and of all thrown 'caused by' exceptions.
